Read in the name of your Lord who created.
He created man from a clinging clot.
Read! Your Lord is the Most Generous.
He is the One who taught by the pen.
He taught man what he did not know.
No! Truly man goes past the limits.
When he sees himself as not needing anyone.
Truly, to your Lord is the return.
Have you seen the one who stops.
A servant of Allah when he prays?
Have you seen if that servant is on guidance?
Or if he tells people to be good?
Have you seen if the one who stops him rejects the truth and turns away?
Does he not know that Allah sees?
No! If he does not stop, We will surely drag him by the front of his head.
Then let him call his group.
We will call the guards of Hell.
No! Do not obey him. Prostrate and come close to Allah.
